title: Fill against a zigzag stitch 4.0 mm on a 40 mm square
description: #955: the #471 baseline square (40 mm outline, Fill 4.5 lines/mm at 45 degrees with under sewing) with zigzag stitch 4.0 mm, 4.5 line/mm, half stitch on. PE-DESIGN's fill reaches the outline whatever the line (2,413 stitches, 40 x 40 mm in every case) and a zigzag is centred on it, so the design is 40 mm plus the zigzag's width; OpenStitch's the same. From 4.0 mm PE-DESIGN sews four under sewing runs 1 mm apart (1.5 and 0.5 mm to either side) instead of two; OpenStitch the same since #964.

references.make: Open compat/reference/stitches/stamp-plain-square-baseline.pes's design in PE-DESIGN 11.50 (or draw it again: a 40 mm square with the rectangle tool, Fill Stitch 4.5 line/mm, 45 degrees, under sewing on) and set only the line: Zigzag Stitch 4.0 mm, 4.5 line/mm, Half Stitch on. Save with Save As as PES (PE-DESIGN 11's default PES version) under the file name given, and record it in compat/reference/MANIFEST.json.

measurements.evidence: the fill reaches the 40 mm outline and the line is centred on it: 44 mm in all
PE-DESIGN 3,448: four under sewing runs from 4.0 mm (3,283 at 3.9 mm)
#978: the fill and the zigzag line, PE-DESIGN 2,413 and 1,035; the line's crossings spaced by the closed outline's outer edge (OpenStitch 1,028; the fill 2,372)
